items.title: Missiles hit Kyiv after Russia agrees to US call to resume Ukraine peace talks
items.summary: Moscow says it is "ready in principle" to resume peace talks and US President Donald Trump says the world is "the closest we've been" to ending the war.

items.title: Rosenberg: US diplomatic push offers little hope for imminent Ukraine peace
items.summary: President Vladimir Putin does not feel under pressure right now to end the war, the BBC's Russia Editor writes.

items.title: Macron accuses foreign leaders of exploiting French riots
items.summary: The comment is an apparent swipe at Benjamin Netanyahu and Donald Trump, who both face elections in coming weeks.

items.title: Pope does not need further treatment after lung cancer surgery
items.summary: Test results have confirmed his diagnosis as a lung adenocarcinoma that was localised.

items.title: 'Targeted' attack on much-loved MP leaves Australian town heartbroken
items.summary: Locals describe the MP, who had to have both legs amputated, as a genuinely kind person who fought for the community.

items.title: Family of prison officer killed by IRA receives state apology
items.summary: Brian Stack was crossing a street in Dublin in 1983 when he was shot in the back of the neck and died 18 months later.
